title: 第1607章 认知壁垒第1606章 打造认知帷幕
slug: 从鹰人进化为天使后我荡平诸神
lines: “我明白了。”
“这是要强行铸造认知壁垒，共铸一层分隔净浊的帷幕！”
佛皇金蟾子耐心听完姜尤的话语，迅速理解，并惊叹不已。
他没有想到，原来那位伟大的圣皇陛下早就已经想到这样的办法。
“圣皇陛下的伟大，我难以望其项背！”
“这样的做法，太精妙了。”
“若是真能做到，那真的就是众生可活了。”
柳暗花明的惊喜让他振作起来。
但很快。
他便想到了这个方法的困难之处。
因为铸造认知帷幕这件事，并不艰难。
认知帷幕，本就源于创世超脱的过程。
他要铸造，只需要再次重复一次部分创世的过程罢了。
但真正难的，是将双方隔绝，尤其是那尊无头的初王身躯，和浊世三王。
若是他战力滔天，能够镇杀这四个存在，便不是困难。
但事实上，他现在绝不是这几尊浊世大敌的对手。
而且他能够铸造的认知高度，也只能抵达他现在所在的地步，同为超脱一级的浊王，轻易就能打破。
于是。
他将自己考虑出的疑惑告知姜尤
“圣皇陛下啊，筑起认知壁垒，隔绝净世浊世，这样的方法，的确可行。”
“但是，我该怎么将初王的身躯和三位浊世之王也分割到浊世的认知壁垒之中呢？”
“浊世三王，冢中枯骨。初王无头身，也不过是空有力量的病虎。”
圣皇的声音淡然无比，带着一种坚定的自信。
“金蟾子。”
“你执我之剑，并行吾之意志！”
“以此炼七王之躯壳，以吾之光辉为引，铸一认知维幕！”
“帷幕内外，则分净浊二世！”
金蟾子听完，顿时明白了姜尤的说法。
他深吸一口气，点了点头。
“我明白了，有您有助，这件事就必定可以成功。”
他抬起眼眸，站起身来，走到那柄从天落下，插在大地上的白金圣剑，看了一眼被撞飞出去的浊世三王，又看了一眼正在朝着元始神山深处悍然踏去的初王无头身躯，悍然拔出插在地上的白金圣剑。
顿时。
一股强横无比的力量，充斥于他的身躯之中，而一抹无上的意志，也附在剑上。
佛皇在这一瞬间，明悟了筑起认知维幕的办法。
他没有犹豫，直接踏空而起，沐浴着白金明月的光辉，用手中的白金圣剑，对着浊世的灰雾和天意挥出一剑！
瞬间。
无比绚烂的煌煌剑光在一切世间亮起，一抹神圣的白和一抹光耀的金在无尽生灵的眼中亮起。
此刻。
所有元始神山范围内，包括上界下界，六大有之地的生灵，都感受到了一种关于意志、灵魂和本质的判定！
就像有威严的执法者在他们的身前，判定他们的存在。
“汝之本质，判定为浊世，当入浊世帷幕。”
“汝之本质，判定为净世，当归于正常世界！“
轰隆隆。
content_en:
"I understand."
"This is to forcibly cast cognitive barriers and create a curtain to separate the pure from the turbid!"
Buddha Emperor Jin Chanzi patiently listened to Jiang You's words, quickly understood, and was amazed.
He did not expect that the great Holy Emperor had already thought of such a method.
"The greatness of His Majesty the Holy Emperor cannot be matched by me!"
"This approach is so exquisite."
"If it can really be done, then all living beings will really be able to live."
The unexpected surprise cheered him up.
But soon.
He then thought of the difficulty of this method.
Because it is not difficult to cast the cognitive curtain.
The cognitive curtain originally originated from the process of creation and transcendence.
To cast it, he only needs to repeat part of the creation process again.
But the really difficult thing is to isolate the two sides, especially the headless body of the First King and the Three Kings of Troubled Times.
If his fighting power is so great that he can kill these four beings, it will not be difficult.
But in fact, he is by no means a match for these great enemies in troubled times.
Moreover, the cognitive height he can create can only reach the point where he is now. King Zhuo, who is also at the first level of transcendence, can easily break through it.
then.
He informed Jiang You of the doubts he had considered.
"Your Majesty the Holy Emperor, it is indeed feasible to build cognitive barriers to isolate the pure and troubled world."
"But how should I separate the body of the First King and the three kings of the troubled world into the cognitive barriers of the troubled world?"
"Three kings in troubled times, withered bones in the grave. The first king has no head and body, and is just a sick tiger with no power."
The Holy Emperor's voice was extremely calm, with a firm confidence.
"Golden Toad."
"You hold my sword and do my will!"
"Refining the body of the seven kings with this, using my brilliance as a guide, to create a cognitive curtain!"
"Inside and outside the curtain, there will be two generations of Jingzhuo!"
After listening to this, Jin Chanzi immediately understood what Jiang You said.
He took a deep breath and nodded.
"I understand, with your help, this matter will definitely succeed."
He raised his eyes, stood up, walked to the platinum holy sword that fell from the sky and was stuck on the ground, glanced at the three kings of the chaotic world who were knocked out, and then looked at the headless body of the first king who was brazenly stepping towards the depths of the Yuanshi Mountain, and brazenly pulled out the platinum holy sword stuck on the ground.
Suddenly.
An extremely powerful force filled his body, and a touch of supreme will was also attached to the sword.
At this moment, the Buddha Emperor clearly understood the method of building a cognitive curtain.
Without hesitation, he jumped directly into the air, bathed in the light of the platinum bright moon, and used the platinum holy sword in his hand to swing a sword against the gray fog and providential will of the troubled world!
moment.
The extremely brilliant sword light lit up in all the world, and a touch of sacred white and a touch of brilliant gold lit up in the eyes of countless creatures.
now.
All creatures within the Yuanshi Mountain, including the upper and lower realms, and the six great places, all feel a judgment about their will, soul, and essence!
It's like a majestic law enforcer is in front of them, judging their existence.
"Your nature is judged to be in troubled times, and you should enter the curtain of troubled times."
"Your essence is judged to be pure, and you should return to the normal world!"
Rumble.
